# StudyMate AI

> AI-powered study companion that explains topics, summarizes content, generates quizzes and creates structured study notes.

StudyMate AI helps students learn faster by combining explanations, summaries, quizzes and note-taking into a single interface powered by Google Gemini.

## Pages
- [Home](/): Product overview and hero.
- [Features](/features): Full list of AI and study features.
- [AI Assistant](/assistant): Generate explanations, summaries, quizzes and notes.
- [Saved Notes](/notes): Locally-stored AI study notes.
- [About](/about): Mission and how the AI feature works.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with the team.
